facts.text: CSUB offers the Finish in Four and Through in Two Program, providing participating students with a dedicated academic advisor and priority registration for each enrollment period.

sources.title: Walk-Ins and Academic Resources | California State University, Bakersfield
sources.quote: Formerly known as the California Promise Program, the Finish in Four and Through in Two Program is a degree pledge program at CSUB
